## Overview

- Name: `go-bridge`
- Languages: Go
- Docs: `README.md`

## Commands

- Build: `go build ./...`
- Test: `go test ./...`
- Combined binary: `go build -o bin/go-bridge.exe ./cmd/go-bridge`
- Process member: `go build -o bin/process-backend.exe ./cmd/process-backend`

## Local environment

- Go is not on PATH. Use `H:\go-sdk\go\bin\go.exe`.
- Offline dependency cache: set `GOMODCACHE=H:\go\pkg\mod` and `GOPROXY=off`.

## Layout

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (Windows + Linux checks, portable artifacts)
- `.env.example` (safe environment template)
- `bin/`
- `bridge/` (Bridge object lifecycle, health, diagnostics, events)
- `cmd/`
- `deploy/` (Tailscale and security notes)
- `internal/bridgecfg/` (config, `.env`, derived paths)
- `internal/clipboard/` (platform clipboard backends)
- `internal/envutil/` (token env stripping)
- `internal/files/` (workspace, staging, quota, cleanup)
- `internal/fileserver/` (HTTP file service)
- `internal/filesmcp/` (MCP file tools)
- `internal/jsonutil/` (JSON encoding helpers)
- `internal/procutil/` (hidden child windows)
- `internal/process/`
- `internal/processmcp/`
- `internal/screenshot/` (capture, inline, cleanup)
- `internal/sysinfo/` (system info and capabilities)
- `internal/systemmcp/` (MCP system tools)
- `logs/`
- `opencode.example.json` (recommended `laptop_*` permissions)
- `scripts/` (`check`, `package`, `start-linux`)
- `specs/`
- `tmp-workspace/`

## Tooling

- `go.mod`

## Notes

- `go-bridge.exe` is a thin CLI adapter over `bridge.NewBridge`.
- `bridge/` tests are black-box MCP/HTTP and cover the 15-tool snapshot plus lifecycle, health, diagnostics, and events.
- The file service is optional; the default workspace is `<data>/workspace`.
- `scripts/check.ps1` / `scripts/check.sh` are the full local gates; `scripts/package.ps1` builds Windows/Linux portable artifacts.
- Prefer project manifests and existing docs over guesses; update this file when commands or structure change.
